name: IronFlux
storyline:
Veyra, the Flux Moon: crater shelves, basalt ridges, mineral forests and inland seas lit by Flux. Three civilizations have each sent a small seed force to claim its ore. The map is alive — native life reacts to every mine, and ancient Monoliths answer to whoever holds their ring.

Cindral Vanguard — the anvil. Dig in and win the long war; units near their own structures shrug off damage.
Zephyrine Court — the knife. Arrive, cut, vanish — faster than every rival, with thinner hulls.
Pelagic Choir — the chorus. Steady everywhere, strongest when they move as one.
summary: Three stranded civilizations fight for the ancient Monoliths of a living moon. Build a streaming economy, field armies on land, sea and air, and hold the map to ascend in a large-scale real-time strategy game.
